_meta.description: Haven is a private, peer-to-peer social app for your close circle. End-to-end encrypted, no central server, no ads, no tracking. iPhone, Mac, Android, Windows, Linux.
_title: Haven — a private home for your people

a-private-message-thread.431b42: A private message thread on iPhone
a-private-peer-to.754370: A private, peer-to-peer, end-to-end-encrypted social app for your close circle. No central server, no ads, no tracking.
a-relay-holds-your.163472: A relay holds your circle's sealed messages while friends are offline, and it can't read them. Any Haven app can be one: turn on “Be your circle's relay” in Settings on a device you leave running, or run a standalone relay.
briefly-while-it-moves.745a46: Briefly, while it moves your bytes, as any internet service would. It never logs or stores it, and there's no name to tie it to. To hide your IP entirely, run Haven behind your own VPN or host your own relay.
can-a-relay-see.c39d6e: Can a relay see my IP address?
conversations-only-your-circle.c4a6a7: Conversations only your circle can open
direct-and-group-messages.185878: Direct and group messages are encrypted on your device before they leave it. No company sits in the middle, reading along.
iphone-ipad-and-mac.12099a: iPhone, iPad and Mac, Android, Windows and Linux. Your people join from whatever they already own.
is-haven-available-in.73a7d5: Is Haven available in the European Union?
made-with-care-for.6c5857: Made with care for the people you love. Haven holds no keys and keeps no copy of your content — your circle is yours alone.
moments-with-a-warm.5b8fc1: Moments with a warm, film-style soul
no-there-s-no.b4b629: No. There's no sign-up, no email and no phone number. Your identity is a set of keys on your own device, and you bring your people in with an invite link.
not-by-a-paid.93689d: Not by a paid outside firm; Haven is free and unfunded. We ran our own adversarial audit, with no critical or high findings. Anyone is welcome to review the code and report findings privately to apps@wemiller.com.
photos-stories-messages-and.5a148f: Photos, stories, messages and calls with the people you love. End-to-end encrypted, peer to peer, and free, with no one in the middle.
share-photos-and-videos.c0f6f5: Share photos and videos with film-style filters, including a warm Kodak Gold look. Add a song, and it plays through each viewer's own music subscription.
the-haven-feed-in.779861: The Haven feed in the desktop app on a Windows laptop
the-haven-feed-on.37f092: The Haven feed on iPhone, with posts from one private circle
the-keys-that-lock.b09221: The keys that lock your moments live on your phone, not on a server. Even we can't read them.
the-promise-never-logged.2d7cd1: The promise: never logged, never sold, never readable. For the full picture, read the threat model and architecture docs.
voice-and-video-calls.72f829: Voice and video calls for your whole circle, with screen sharing built in. End-to-end encrypted, like everything else.
what-is-a-relay.77fc09: What is a relay, and do I need one?
yes-in-every-eu.d93f01: Yes, in every EU country except France, where apps that use encryption need a separate government declaration. The source code is open to everyone on GitHub.
yes-on-every-platform.565327: Yes, on every platform: no ads, no tracking, no subscription and no in-app purchases. Haven runs no servers of its own, so there's nothing to bill you for. Development is funded by people who choose to support it.
